Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Makeda reaches Jerusalem and is lodged and feasted by Solomon, whose wisdom and craft astonish her. In ch. 26 she praises his wisdom and wishes to serve him; he answers that wisdom is God's gift, names himself a servant of the Ark, Zion, and describes his creation from earth, water and spittle in God's image.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፭ is 20 + 5 = 25. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ- + ከመ 'as, thus'; it heads a clause of manner and is common in these headings). በጽሐት is the 3fs perfect of በጽሐ 'arrive, reach' (the -ት ending marks 'she'); ኀበ here is 'to' (elsewhere in headings it is 'where'). ሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'Solomon the king' is a plain noun-plus-title, not a construct.

sentences.l: And-she-arrived Jerusalem, and-she-brought gifts to-the-king, many, honor which is-needed for-him;
sentences.i: She reached Jerusalem and brought the king gifts, many of them, as the honor that was fitting for him;
sentences.n: ወበጽሐት 'and she arrived' (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect); the verb takes ኢየሩሳሌም directly, 'she arrived (at) Jerusalem', with no preposition. ወአብአት 'and she brought in' (አብአ, the causative of ቦአ 'enter'; 3fs). አምኃ 'gifts, tribute' (accusative). ለንጉሥ 'to the king' (ለ- marks the recipient). ብዙኀ ክብረ: ብዙኀ is the accusative of ብዙኅ 'many' (used adverbially, as in the glossary), and ክብረ is a second accusative, 'as honor', standing in apposition to the gifts. It is not a construct, because the noun after a construct stands bare, without the -ä; the relative clause that follows belongs to ክብረ, 'honor that is fitting for him'. ዘይትፈቀድ ሎቱ: ዘ- 'which' + ይትፈቀድ, the passive-reflexive of ፈቀደ 'desire', 'is needed / is fitting' (as in the glossary), + ሎቱ 'for him' (ለ- + -ቱ). The queen came to Jerusalem at the end of her journey in ch. 24; this is the first scene of the meeting.

sentences.l: and-he-also honored-her and-rejoiced, and-gave-her a-lodging in-the-[taʿka] of-kingdom which is-near to-him.
sentences.i: and he honored her and rejoiced, and gave her lodging in the royal palace (?) that was near his own.
sentences.n: ወውእቱኒ 'and he for his part' (ውእቱ 'he' + enclitic -ኒ, which here contrasts him with her; ወ- 'and'). አክበራ is አክበረ 'honor' (causative of ከበረ) + -ኣ 'her'. ወተፈሥሐ 'and he rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ, a ተ- stem of ፈሥሐ). ወወሀባ 'and he gave her' (ወሀበ + -ኣ). ማኅደረ 'a lodging, dwelling' (ማኅደር; accusative -ä). በታዕካ መንግሥት: በ- 'in' + ታዕካ + መንግሥት 'of kingdom', a construct 'tāʿka of the kingdom'. I do not firmly know ታዕካ (Dillmann is not available): it looks like ታዕክ 'a roofed court, palace hall', which fits 'royal palace', so I read 'the royal palace' with a (?). ዘቅሩብ ኀቤሁ 'which is near to him' (ቅሩብ 'near' + ኀቤሁ 'to/with him'; ኀበ takes the pronoun suffix).

sentences.i: He sent her an evening meal and a midday meal each time: fifteen measures of [qori] fine flour, boiled and cooked, with plenty of oil and [mäṭabq] (?); and thirty measures of [qori] fine flour, kneaded (?), of which three hundred and fifty loaves were made, with [ṭäbiqu] (?) in [zäbadw] (?);
sentences.n: ወይፌኑ 'and he would send' (ፈነወ 'send'; the imperfect ይፌኑ with ወ- is habitual: 'he used to send'). ላቲ 'to her' (ለ- + -ቲ). ድራረ 'supper' and ምሳሐ 'midday meal' (ድራር, ምሳሕ) are accusatives. ለለ አሐቲ ጊዜ 'each single time' (ለለ is itself the distributive 'each, every', not ለ- + ለ; አሐቲ is the feminine form of 'one'). Numerals are words here: ፲ወ፭ 'fifteen' (10 and 5), ፴ 'thirty', ፫፻ወ፶ 'three hundred and fifty'. መስፈርተ is the construct of መስፈርት 'measure'; ቆሪ is not known to me for certain (a dry measure or a vessel, ?), so I leave it as [qori]. ስንዳሌ 'fine wheat flour'; ስሉቀ 'boiled' and ብሱለ 'cooked' are accusative adjectives (from ሰልቀ and በሰለ). ቅብእ 'oil, ointment'. መጣብቅ: I take it for a cooking-dish or sauce, uncertain; ብዙኅ 'much' follows both ቅብእ and መጣብቅ, so it covers both. ልቱመ 'kneaded' (from ለተመ?, uncertain). በዘተገብረ ኅብስተ 'from which bread was made' (በ- 'by' + ዘ- 'that which' + ተገብረ 'was made', the passive of ገብረ; ኅብስተ keeps the accusative -ä although the verb is passive). ጠቢቁ and በዘባድው I cannot identify and leave transliterated. This list of provisions is Solomon's lavish hospitality; the numbers are reproduced as Bezold prints them.

sentences.i: and ten fatted oxen, five [ʿaswar] (?), fifty sheep (not counting ibex, deer, [tora] (?), and fattened fowl), and jars (?) of wine, eight measures of [gərät] (?) and thirty [kärami] (?); and twenty-five each of the [mäzaryan] and the [mäzaryat] (?), together with [ṣäqawʿä] (?) and [mäʿanṭä] (?), and some of his own food that he ate and of the drink that he drank.
sentences.n: መግዝዓ is the construct of መግዝዕ 'fatling, fattened animal'; ላህም 'ox, cattle' (ወ before ፭ in ላህምወ ፭ is only the 'and', run on to the word in Bezold). ዓስዋር is unknown to me. ዘእንበለ 'apart from, without' (ዘ- + እንበለ). ወይጠል 'ibex, mountain goat', ሀየል 'stag, deer', ቶራ I take for a wild ox or antelope, uncertain; መግዝአ ዶርሆ 'fattened of fowl' (construct again). ጻሕበ ወይን 'jars of wine' (ጻሕብ is a vessel; the accusative -ä); ፰ መሳፍረ ግረት ወከራሚ ፴ I cannot parse with confidence: መሳፍር 'measures', ግረት and ከራሚ are not known to me. መዛርያን / መዛርያት look like masculine and feminine plurals of a nomen agentis, perhaps 'cooks' or 'attendants' (?). በበ፳ወ፭ 'by twenty-five each' (the distributive በበ + 25). ጸቃውዐ and መዓንጠ unidentified. ሲሳዩ 'his food' (ሲሳይ + -ሁ, with the vowel run together); ዘይበልዕ 'which he eats' (ዘ- + ይበልዕ of በልዐ); ስታይ 'drink', ዘይሰቲ 'which he drinks' (ሰትየ). The sense is clear even where single words are not: a royal ration, with something from Solomon's own table.

sentences.l: And-for-each day he-clothes-her in-each 11 which dazzle(?) eyes;
sentences.i: and every day he had her clothed in eleven garments each, which dazzled the eye (?);
sentences.n: ወለለ ዕለት 'and every day' (ወ- + ለለ 'each, every', itself the distributive as in the last unit, + ዕለት 'day'). ያለብስ 'he clothes (her)' (አልበሰ, the causative of ለብሰ 'wear'; the object is understood). በበ ፲ወ፩ 'in each of 11': the distributive በበ + the number, so 'eleven apiece' (garments are understood). ዘየሀይድ አዕይንተ: ዘ- 'which' + የሀይድ (so spelled; 3ms imperfect) + አዕይንተ 'eyes'. The verb ሀየደ I do not know securely; 'dazzle' is a guess from the context of bright clothes, so mark (?).

sentences.l: And-he-goes to-her and-converses, and-she-also goes to-him and-converses, and-she-sees his-wisdom and-his-judgment and-his-glory and-his-grace and-the-sweetness-of his-speech;
sentences.i: He went to her and conversed with her, and she went to him and conversed with him, and she saw his wisdom and his judgment, his glory and his grace, and the sweetness of his speech;
sentences.n: A string of present-habitual verbs (the imperfect is used for repeated action in narrative): ወየሐውር 'and he goes' (ሖረ), ወይትናዘዝ 'and he converses' (ተናዘዘ, the reciprocal ተ- stem), then the same in the feminine, ወይእቲኒ ተሐውር 'and she too goes' (ይእቲ 'she' + -ኒ; ት- marks the 3fs imperfect), ወትትናዘዝ. ወትሬኢ 'and she sees' (ርእየ). Then a list of accusative objects with -ሁ 'his' (after the accusative -ä the suffix contracts to -o: ጥበቦ, ፍትሖ, ክብሮ, ሞገሶ): ጥበብ, ፍትሕ 'judgment, justice', ክብር, ሞገስ 'grace, majesty', and ጣዕመ ነገሩ, the construct 'sweetness-of his speech'. Pairs of verbs, 'goes // converses', give the passage its slow, courtly rhythm.

sentences.l: And-she-marvels in-her-heart, and-sets-her-mind(?) in-her-mind, and-examines in-knowledge, and-observes(?) with-her-eyes how it-is-fitting, and-is-astonished exceedingly concerning what she-saw and-heard with-him;
sentences.i: She marveled in her heart, and took thought (?) in her mind, and examined it with her understanding, and watched with her own eyes how fitting it all was, and was astonished beyond measure at what she had seen and heard in his presence;
sentences.n: Four verbs in the 3fs imperfect (ት-), each with a prefix of its stem: ታነክር 'she marvels' (አንከረ), ታስተአድም (አስተአደመ, an አስተ- (ʾastä-) stem; as in ch. 23 I read 'sets her mind, takes thought', and the sense is uncertain, ?), ትጤይቅ 'she examines' (ጠየቀ), ታስተሓይጽ (አስተሐየጸ, 'observe, look closely', ?), ታስተዐጽብ 'she is astonished' (አስተዐጽበ, rendered as at ch. 22 ያስተዐጽብ; ch. 23 read the same form 'reckons hard', so the sense is not secure, ?). Each is joined to its instrument by በ-: በልባ 'in her heart' (ልብ + -ኣ), በኅሊናሃ 'in her mind', በአእምሮ 'in knowledge', በአዕይንቲሃ 'with her eyes'. ዘከመ መፍትው 'how (it was) fitting' (መፍትው 'proper, fitting'). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. በእንተ ዘርእየት ወሰምዐት 'concerning that which she saw and heard' (በእንተ 'concerning'; both verbs are 3fs perfect, ርእየት, ሰምዐት). The queen's amazement here echoes 1 Kings 10:4–7 (2 Chronicles 9:3–6), where she sees Solomon's wisdom and 'there was no more spirit in her'.

The clause gives the content of what she concluded. ወጠቢብ 'and wise' takes its በ- phrase in the next unit (ጠቢብ በኅሊና 'wise in thought'), the same pattern as ፍሡሕ በጸጋ and ላሕይ በግርማ there; the unit break falls at Bezold's ።.

sentences.i: in thought, and cheerful in grace, handsome in majesty; his speech exact, his lips sweet (?), his commands awe-inspiring, and his answers peaceable, joined with the fear of God.
sentences.n: A series of qualities, 'X in Y', each X an adjective or noun with a በ- phrase: በኅሊና 'in thought' (completing ወጠቢብ of the last unit, 'wise in thought'); ፍሡሕ 'cheerful' በጸጋ 'in grace/favor'; ላሕይ 'handsome, fair' በግርማ 'in majesty, awe'; ቃሉ-ኒ 'his word also' በጥይቅና 'in exactness' (ጥይቅ 'exact', with the abstract ending -ና); ከናፍረሁኒ 'his lips also' (ከናፍር) በሥእሥእና: the word is rare and I take it as 'sweetness' from ሣእሣአ in ch. 22 and in ch. 26 below (left untranslated in ch. 22), uncertain; ትእዛዙኒ 'his commands also' (ትእዛዝ + -ሁ + -ኒ) በግርማ; ወዘበሰላም 'and that which is in peace'. ምስለ ፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሐር 'with the fear-of God' (ፍርሀተ is the construct of ፍርሃት; Bezold spells God's name with a rare ሐ in እግዚኣብሐር, a variant spelling of እግዚኣብሔር). አውሥኦቶ 'his answers' (አውሥኦት + -ሁ). The 'fear of God' is the biblical beginning of wisdom (Proverbs 1:7; Psalm 111:10), here Solomon's mark.

sentences.i: All this she saw, and she was astonished at the abundance of his wisdom: not one thing in his speech or his words was [nətugä] (?), but all that he said was perfect.
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ኵሎ 'and all this' (ዘንተ is the accusative of ዝ 'this'). ትሬኢ 'she sees'; ታስተዐጽብ 'she is astonished' as in the last paragraph. እምብዝኀ ጥበቡ 'from the abundance of his wisdom' (እም- 'from, because of' + ብዝኀ the construct of ብዝኅ 'abundance'; ጥበቡ 'his wisdom'). ወአልቦ ወኢምንትኒ 'and there is not anything at all' (አልቦ 'there is not'; ኢምንት 'nothing, anything at all' (ኢ- + ምንት 'what'), with -ኒ 'even'). ንቱገ I cannot identify; the sense required is 'faulty, blameworthy', but I have not found it. Transliterated and marked (?). አላ 'but'; ፍጹም ኴሉ 'perfect (was) all'; ዘተናገረ 'which he spoke'. The ፨ ends the first stretch of the narrator's description of Solomon.

sentences.l: And-he-is-engaged for-the-building-of house-of God, and-rises and-goes right and-left, forward and-back, and-shows-them measures and-balances and-[mäsawr](?);
sentences.i: He busied himself with the building of the house of God; he rose and went to the right and to the left, forward and back, and showed the workmen measures and balances and the [mäsawr] (?);
sentences.n: ወይትጌበር: the long vowel after the first radical suggests the ተፋዕለ-type ተ- stem of ገብረ (the associative, effortful type, as in ተጋብአ), 'busies himself, labours' (?); the ጌ is an unusual spelling for ጋ. It is not the passive ይትገበር 'is done', which appears two units on. ለሕንጻ 'for the building' (ለ- + ሕንጻ, the verbal noun of ሐነጸ); ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር is a construct, 'house-of God': the Temple in Jerusalem, built by Solomon (1 Kings 5–6). ይትነሣእ 'he rises'. ይምነ ወፅግመ ቅድመ ወድኅረ: ይምን 'right', ፅግም 'left', ቅድመ 'before', ድኅረ 'after, behind'. ወያርእዮሙ 'and shows them' (አርአየ, the causative of ርእየ, + ሙ 'them'; the workmen). መሳፍር 'measures', መዳልው 'balances'; መሳውር is unidentified: ch. 17–20 left ወመሳውረ untranslated and I do the same, since 'cords' would be a guess from the building context.

sentences.i: For the working of gold (?) he told them the measures (?) and the [mäwaqr] (?) and the [mägʷanp̣ət] (?), and for the cutting of stone he showed them the scales, the wheel, and the [mäsafḥä] (?).
sentences.n: ለኬነተ ነሀብት 'for the craft-of gold': ኬነት 'craft, workmanship' is a construct before ነሀብት (which I take as 'gold', ?); ወለወቀርተ እብንኒ 'and for the cutting-of stone' (ወቀርት 'hewing', and እብን 'stone' with -ኒ). ይነግሮሙ 'he tells them' (ነገረ) and ያርእዮሙ 'he shows them' balance the two crafts, 'tells' (technical instruction) and 'shows' (a demonstration). Tools: መሳፍል, which I take as a spelling of መሳፍር 'measures' with ል for ር, as in the last unit (?), then መዋቅር and መጓንጵት (both unidentified, probably measuring and weighing instruments); መኣዝን 'scales, balance' (ሚዛን); መንኰራኵር 'wheel' (a windlass or pulley?); መሳፍሕ (?). I have transliterated the unclear words. The detail of Solomon directing masons and goldsmiths recalls the instructions in 1 Chronicles 28:11–19, where David gives Solomon the plans.

sentences.i: for the light of his heart was like a lamp in the midst of darkness, and the abundance of his wisdom was like the sand, and nothing was hidden from him, not the voice of the beasts and birds; and even the demons he brought into subjection by his wisdom.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for' opens a reason. ከመ ማኅቶት በውስተ ጽልመት 'like a lamp in the midst of darkness' (በውስተ 'in the middle of'); the figure of the light in darkness recalls Psalm 119:105 and John 1:5, and the queen uses it again in her praise (ch. 26). ብርሃነ ልቡ 'the light-of his heart' (a construct). ኆጻ 'sand' (I read it as ኆጻ 'sand', a common figure of immeasurability: the 'sand of the sea' with which God's gift of wisdom is compared in 1 Kings 4:29). ብዝኀ ጥበቡ 'abundance-of his wisdom'. ዘይሰወሮ 'which hides from him' (ዘ- + ይሰውር + -ሁ; ሰወረ is transitive, so literally 'what hides (it) from him', with እም- partitive: nothing of the voice of beasts and birds was hidden from him). እምቃለ አራዊት ወአዕዋፍ 'from the voice-of beasts and birds'; the tradition that Solomon understood the speech of animals is later Jewish and Islamic legend, not found in Kings itself. ወለዓጋንንትኒ 'and the demons too' (ለ- fronts the object, which ቀነዮሙ 'he subdued them' then repeats with -ሙ; -ኒ 'also'); ቀነዮሙ 'he subdued them / made them serve' (ቀነየ, 'serve; make subject'), the legend that Solomon ruled demons (in the Testament of Solomon).

sentences.i: for he did not ask for victory over his enemy, nor did he ask for wealth and honor; he asked for wisdom and knowledge, that God might give him the means to rule his people, to build his house, and to make his work for God fine, in all that he gave him of wisdom and knowledge.
sentences.n: መዊአ ፀሩ 'victory (over) his enemy' (መዊእ 'victory' is a construct before ፀሩ 'his enemy', the object); ወኢሰአለ ብዕለ ወክብረ 'nor did he ask riches and honor' (ብዕል, ክብር, accusatives). ጥበበ ወአእምሮ 'wisdom and knowledge'. ከመ የሀቦ 'that he might give him' (ከመ + የሀብ, the 3ms subjunctive of ወሀበ, with -ኦ 'him'; God is the subject). Three clauses with በዘ 'by that which, wherewith': ይኴንን 'he might judge, rule' (ኰነነ), የሐንጽ 'he might build' (ሐነጸ), ያሤኒ 'he might beautify, make good' (አሠነየ); ተግባሮ 'his work'. The thought follows 1 Kings 3:9–11: Solomon asks an understanding heart to judge, not long life, riches or the death of his enemies; 'his house' (ቤቶ) may be Solomon's own house or the Temple, which the text elsewhere calls ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር; the work 'for God' (ተግባሮ ለእግዚኣብሔር) is more probably the Temple. The two ፨ close ch. 25.

sentences.i: As for me, if I wished, I would be as one of the least of your maidservants, that I might wash your feet and hear your wisdom, understand your knowledge, serve your kingdom, and delight in your wisdom.
sentences.n: አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + contrastive -ሰ). እምፈተውኩ is እም- + ፈተውኩ: the 1cs perfect of ፈተወ 'wish'; I read 'if I wished' as in ch. 23 (twice), the house rendering; 'I would rather' is the other possible sense, and the reading is uncertain (?). እኩን 'that I be' (the subjunctive of ኮነ). ከመ አሐቲ እንተ ትንእስ 'like one who is small' (እንተ is the feminine relative, ትንእስ 'she is small/least'). እምአእማቲከ 'of/among your maidservants' (እም- 'of, from' + አእማት, the plural of አመት 'maidservant', + -ከ 'your'). Five verbs in the subjunctive, each beginning with እ- (1cs): ከመእኅፅብ 'that I wash' (ከመ run on), እስማዕ 'I hear', እለቡ 'I understand' (ለበወ), እግነይ 'I serve' (ገነየ), እትሐሠይ 'I rejoice' (ተሐሠየ). Washing a lord's feet is the humblest service; compare Abigail in 1 Samuel 25:41. Her wish to be the least of his maidservants answers his own claim to be a servant later in this chapter.

sentences.n: ሚመጠነ 'how much, how greatly' (a ሚ- interrogative used as an exclamation). Only አውሥኦትከ can be the subject of አደመኒ; the nouns after it stand in the accusative (ጣዕመ, ሠናየ, ሣእሣአ) or bare (አዳም), so they are loosely coordinated or depend on an understood verb; I render them as further subjects. አደመኒ 'pleased me' (አደመ, 'please', + -ኒ 'me'). Its subjects, in a list: አውሥኦትከ 'your answers', ጣዕመ ቃልከ 'the sweetness-of your word' (construct), ሠናየ ሑረትከ 'the goodness-of your conduct' (ሑረት 'going, behavior', from ሖረ), አዳም ንባብከ 'the pleasantness (?) of your speech' (ንባብ 'speech, reading'), ሣእሣአ ጣዕመ ቃልከ (ሣእሣአ is the noun left untranslated at ch. 22, unidentified; it is not 'sweetness', which is the next word, so the phrase does not simply repeat the earlier ጣዕመ ቃልከ). The last lines name the effects with a string of causative verbs (the ʾa- stem, and ያስተፈሥሕ the ʾastä- stem): ያስተፈሥሕ ልበ 'it makes the heart rejoice', ያጠልል አዕፅምተ 'it refreshes (lit. shades) the bones' (?), ይሜግብ ዓልባበ (unknown), ያጠአጥእ (unknown), ያሞግስ ከናፍረ 'makes the lips gracious' (ሞገስ 'grace'), ያጸንዕ መከይደ 'strengthens the tread' (መከይድ 'tread', from ከይደ, as in ch. 18 and ch. 24; the sense here is uncertain, ?). The parallel with Proverbs 16:24, 'pleasant words are as a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and health to the bones', is plain, and 'bones' as a seat of feeling is Psalm 51:8 (I note the echo only).

sentences.i: I see that your wisdom is without measure and your understanding without lack, like a lamp in the darkness, like a pomegranate in a garden, like a pearl in the sea, like the morning star among the stars, like the light of the moon in the gloom (?), like the break of dawn and the rising of the sun in the sky.
sentences.n: ወእሬእየከ 'and I see you' (1cs imperfect እሬኢ + -ከ 'you'; the construction takes ከመ 'that' with a nominal clause). ዘእንበለ መስፈርት 'without measure', ዘእንበለ ሕጸት 'without lack' (ዘእንበለ 'without'). A string of similes, each ከመ + noun + በውስተ 'in the midst of': ማኅቶት 'lamp'; ሮማን 'pomegranate' (compare Song of Songs 4:3, 13); ባሕርይ 'pearl' (also 'nature'; here 'pearl' fits the sea); ኮከበ ጽባሕ 'morning star' (construct; compare Revelation 22:16, and Isaiah 14:12 for the Hebrew form); ብርሃነ ወርኅ 'light-of the moon'; ጊሜ I take as 'dark, cloud, gloom' (?); ጎሐ ጽባሕ 'dawn' (lit. 'breaking-of morning'); ሠርቀ ፀሐይ 'rising-of the sun'. The sequence climbs from lamp to sun. The lamp in darkness is the same figure the narrator used for Solomon's heart (previous chapter).

sentences.i: And as for me, I give thanks to him who brought me and showed me you, who made me come to the threshold of your gates, and who let me hear your word.'
sentences.n: ወአንሰ 'and as for me' (ወ- + አንሰ). ኣአኵቶ is the 1cs imperfect of አኰተ 'give thanks, praise' (ኣ- is the 1cs prefix and the root's own አ follows it; the final -ቶ is the object suffix -ኦ 'him', taken up by ለዘ 'to him who'); ለዘ 'to him who' (ለ- + ዘ-). Four verbs with the 1cs object -ኒ 'me': አብጽሐኒ 'brought me' (አብጽሐ, the causative of በጽሐ 'arrive'; the same root as in ch. 25), አርዓየኒ 'showed me' (አርአየ), አኬደኒ 'made me go' (አኬደ), አስምዐኒ 'made me hear' (አስምዐ). ኪያከ 'you' as object (ኪያ- + -ከ). መድረከ ኆኃቲከ 'the threshold-of your gates' (መድረክ 'step, threshold', construct, then ኆኃት 'gates'). She does not name the God she thanks. The ፨ ends her speech.

sentences.i: King Solomon answered and said to her: 'As for wisdom and understanding, it is from you that they have sprung;
sentences.n: ዓውሥአ 'he answered' (the 3ms perfect, the usual አውሥአ spelled with a long initial vowel). ወይቤላ 'and he said to her' (ወ- + ይቤ 'he said', the 3ms perfect of the irregular verb 'say', + -ላ 'to her'). ጥበብሰ 'as for wisdom' (ጥበብ + the contrastive -ሰ). ወልቡና 'and understanding' (ልቡና). እምኔኪ 'from you' (እምኔ- + -ኪ, the 2fs 'you'; he addresses her with the feminine suffix). ሠረጸት 'sprouted, grew forth' (ሠረጸ, 3fs, agreeing with the feminine ጥበብ). This is a courteous reversal: he gives her the credit for wisdom, before he describes its true source. The plant-image (ሠረጸ, of sprouting) comes into the next unit as አሥረጽኪ 'you brought forth'.

sentences.i: As for me, it is by what the God of Israel gave me, what I asked and sought of him; but you, without knowing the God of Israel, have brought this wisdom forth from your heart, so that you can look upon me, a humble servant of my God and an attendant at his tent, who stand and serve and go about for my lady, the Ark of the Law of the God of Israel: Zion, holy and heavenly.
sentences.n: ሊተሰ 'as for me' (ሊተ is the oblique form of አነ, + -ሰ). The clause has no verb: 'as for me, (it is) by what...'. በዘ ወሀበኒ 'by what gave me' (በ- + ዘ- + ወሀበኒ, 'gave me'). አምላከ እስራኤል 'God-of Israel' (a construct). ዘሰአልኩ ወኀሠሥኩ በኀቤሁ 'which I asked and sought of him' (1cs perfects, ሰአለ 'ask', ኀሠሠ 'seek'). ወአንቲሰ 'and as for you' (አንቲ 'you', fs, + -ሰ). እንዘ ኢታአምሪ 'while you do not know' (እንዘ + the negative imperfect 2fs of አእመረ 'know'). ዘአሥረጽኪ 'which you brought forth' (አሥረጸ, the causative of ሠረጸ, + 2fs -ኪ). ከመ ትርዓዪ ኪያየ 'that you see me' (the 2fs subjunctive ትርዓዪ; ኪያየ 'me'). ትሑተ 'humble' (accusative). ገብሩ ለዓምላኪየ 'servant to my God' (ለ-; Bezold writes ዓምላኪየ). ቀዋሚሃ ለደብተራሁ 'the one who stands at his tent' (ቀዋሚ 'one who stands, attendant', with a pronoun anticipating the noun, -ሃ). ዘእቀውም ወእትለአክ ወኣንሶሱ 'who stand and serve and go about': ተለአከ 'serve as minister, be sent' (?), and ኣንሶሱ, the 1cs imperfect of ነሶሰወ 'walk about' (a four-radical verb). ለእግዝእትየ ታቦተ ሕጉ: 'for my lady, the ark-of his law' (the Ark is called 'my lady' because ታቦት is feminine; ለ- is 'for, in service of', not 'before'; ታቦተ is the construct and ሕጉ 'his law' its genitive, which ለአምላከ እስራኤል then names, 'his law, of the God of Israel', the same anticipating pattern as ገብሩ ለአምላኪየ). The Ark is called Zion, 'holy and heavenly' (ጽዮን ቅድስት ሰማያዊት): this is the Kebra Nagast's basic theology, that the Ark is the dwelling of God's glory and is the true Zion; Solomon here tells the queen of it, perhaps for the first time. The heavenly pattern of the sanctuary is Hebrews 8:5 and Exodus 25:40.

'from beside me'; ኀበ takes -የ). ውእቱ ዘአንበበኒ እነብብ 'he (is) the one who made me speak; I speak': አንበበ is the causative of ነበበ 'speak', + -ኒ; ውእቱ 'he' is the subject, ዘአንበበኒ (relative + perfect) its predicate 'the one who made me', with no copula, and እነብብ 'I speak' is the main verb. sentences.l: for while earth I, flesh he-made-me, and-while water I, man curdled he-made-me, and-while a-drop, a-little spittle which is-spat on earth and-dries on the-surface-of earth, in-his-image he-formed(?)-me and-in-his-likeness he-made-me.
sentences.i: For though I was earth, he made me flesh; though I was water, he made me a man, curdled; and though I was a drop, a little spittle that is spat upon the ground and dries on the face of the earth, he formed (?) me in his image and made me in his likeness.'
sentences.n: እስመ እንዘ 'for while' (እንዘ + a noun clause: 'being earth'). መሬት 'earth, soil' (compare Genesis 2:7, 'dust of the ground'), አነ ሥጋ 'I (am) flesh'; ረሰየኒ 'made me' (ረሰየ 'make, set, appoint'). ማይ 'water'; ሰብዓ ርጉዐ 'man, curdled': ርጉዕ is 'curdled, congealed', and the picture of the body formed from water and coagulated like milk or cheese is Job 10:10 (I note the echo only). ነጠብጣብ ንስቲት 'a little drop' (ንስቲት 'small'); ምራቅ 'spittle'; ትተፋእ 'is spat' (ተፍአ, 3fs; እንተ and ትተፋእ agree with the feminine ነጠብጣብ 'drop', ምራቅ standing in apposition); ትየብስ 'dries'; መልዕልተ ምድር 'the surface/top of the earth'. በአርአያሁ ለሐኰኒ ወበአምሳሊሁ ገብረኒ 'in his image he formed me, and in his likeness he made me' (ለሐኰኒ: root uncertain, perhaps ለሐከ 'shape, mold', but a plain ለሐከ would not give the ኰ (kʷä); 'formed' is a guess from the parallel ገብረኒ, ?; አርአያ 'image', አምሳል 'likeness'): the language of Genesis 1:26, 'let us make man in our image, after our likeness'. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the chapter and the part.

glossary.ወይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — and he rises (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ንሥአ)
glossary.ወይትናዘዝ: ተናዘዘ — and he converses (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem, 'confess, converse')
glossary.ወይትጌበር: ተጋብረ — and he is engaged, busies himself (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem; ጌ is an irregular spelling for ጋ) (?)
glossary.ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይጠል: ወይጠል — ibex, wild goat (noun; the initial ወ is part of the word, not 'and', since it is the first item after ዘእንበለ and the next two items carry their own ወ-) (?)
glossary.ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send')
glossary.ወጣዕመ: ጣዕም — and sweetness of (ወ- + noun, construct, accusative)
glossary.ወጸቃውዐ: ጸቃውዕ — and [ṣäqawʿä], unidentified dish or vessel (ወ- + noun, accusative) (?)
glossary.ወጻሕበ: ጻሕብ — and jar of (ወ- + noun, construct; sense from the context) (?)
glossary.ወፅግመ: ፅግም — and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')
glossary.ወፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዓምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct; variant spelling ዓምላከ)
glossary.ዓውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative; written ዓውሥአ)
glossary.ዘመሀረኒ: መሀረ — who taught me (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘሠርሐኒ: ሠርሐ — who set me on my way (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘርእየት: ርእየ — what she saw (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘሰአልኩ: ሰአለ — which I asked (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, G)
glossary.ዘቅሩብ: ቅሩብ — which is near (ዘ- relative + adjective ቅሩብ 'near', masc. sg.)
glossary.ዘተናገረ: ተናገረ — which spoke, that speaks (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem of ነገረ)
glossary.ዘአሥረጽኪ: አሥረጸ — which you brought forth (ዘ- relative + 2fs perfect, causative of ሠረጸ)
glossary.ዘአንበበኒ: አንበበ — who made me speak (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of ነበበ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘአዘዘኒ: አዘዘ — who commanded me (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘአጥበበኒ: አጥበበ — who made me wise (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of ጠበበ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘእቀውም: ቆመ — who stand (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, G, q-w-m)
glossary.ዘእትለአክ: ተለአከ — who ministers, serves (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, tä-stem; 'is sent' also possible) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
glossary.ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
glossary.ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ዘየሀይድ: ሀየደ — which dazzles (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G; root and sense uncertain)
glossary.ዘይሰቲ: ሰትየ — which he drinks (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይሰወሮ: ሰወረ — what hides from him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይበልዕ: በልዐ — which he eats (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይትዐደው: ተዐደወ — who transgresses (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.የሀቦ: ወሀበ — that he give him (3ms jussive, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ያለብስ: አልበሰ — he clothes (3ms imperfect, causative of ለብሰ; the object 'her' is not marked)
glossary.ያሤኒ: አሠነየ — he make good, adorn (3ms jussive, causative of ሠነየ)
glossary.ያርእዮሙ: አርአየ — he shows them (3ms imperfect, causative of ርእየ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይምነ: የማን — right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይነግሮሙ: ነገረ — he tells them (3ms imperfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ገብረኒ: ገብረ — he made me (3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-)
glossary.ጊሜ: ጊሜ — [gime], cloud or darkness, night (?) (noun, uncertain)
glossary.ግረት: ግረት — [gərät], a measure or vessel size (noun, unidentified) (?)
glossary.ጠቢቁ: ጠቢቅ — [ṭäbiqu], unidentified (a sauce or relish?); perhaps noun + -ሁ '3ms his' (?)
glossary.ጥበብሰ: ጥበብ — wisdom, as for her (noun, fem. + contrastive -ሰ) · 'as for wisdom' (ጥበብ + the topic-marking -ሰ: ጥበብሰ ወልቡና እምኔኪ ሠረጸት)
glossary.ጥበቦ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')
glossary.፫፻ወ፶: ፫፻ወ፶ — 350, spoken ሠለስቱ ምእት ወኀምሳ (śälästu məʾət wä-ḫaməsa) 'three hundred and fifty' (numeral)
glossary.፳፭: ፳፭ — 25, spoken ዕሥራ ወኀምስቱ (ʿəśra wä-ḫaməstu) 'twenty-five'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፳፮: ፳፮ — 26, spoken ዕሥራ ወስድስቱ (ʿəśra wä-sədstu) 'twenty-six'; chapter number (numeral)
